profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. Its website is spacex.com.

The company is recorded as a for-profit public company with headquarters in Starbase, Texas, trading under the ticker SPCX and holding CIK 0001181412. Its legal exposure is recorded in Texas, with 88 matters counted there. No lawsuits, AI products, or MCP servers appear in the material held on the company, and the text from its own site describes rockets and spacecraft rather than AI offerings.
